title: fix(react): usePageAssignment opens the object's default record page (objectui#12195)
body:
Fixes #12195

Clause-②: no

## What changes

`usePageAssignment` (`@object-ui/react`, the record-page pick behind `RecordDetailView`) now opens the object's **default record page**. Among the served pages with `type: 'record'` and the requested `object`, the one the spec reads as the object's default wins; with no default, declaration order decides as before; an explicit `pageName` still wins outright.

- **The rule it follows.** Maintainer ruling A on objectstack-ai/objectstack#23015 (record `6134056653`), landed as objectstack `5f37d36ce3` and installed here through `@objectstack/spec` 18.0.0-next.1: at most one `isDefault: true` record page may exist for an object in a deployment, and a second is refused, naming both pages, by `defineStack` / `composeStacks` (so `os validate` and a source boot), at package registration and at metadata save. The ruling's renderer half, verbatim: "The renderer then honours `isDefault` with no tie-break." This hook adds no tie-break, option, key or precedence rung.
- **One reading, not a second spelling.** The hook asks `defaultRecordPageObject` from `@objectstack/spec/ui`, the function every refusing door asks. Inside the candidate set (already `type: 'record'` and the requested `object`), that answer is exactly `isDefault === true`. `@objectstack/spec` is already a runtime dependency of the package, and `src/SchemaRenderer.tsx` already imports values from `@objectstack/spec/ui`.
- **Placement.** The preference runs after the filter, so the `type` discriminator, the `object` match and `matchesAssignment` keep their meaning (pinned: another object's default, and a `list` page flagged default for the same object, do not displace the record page).
- **The stated boundary.** One path still delivers two defaults: at a cold boot every package registers before the environment's stored pages hydrate, so a stored default saved while no package held that object's default and a package that adds one later both reach the registry unrefused (objectstack-ai/objectstack#23213, closed `not_planned`; the objectql module doc of `default-record-page.ts` states it). The hook's comment names this case. For that pair the hook invents no rung: served order stays its only order, so the first default served wins. A pin holds that, so a precedence rule cannot be added here unannounced.

## Who sees a different page

An app or an environment that authors a record page **without** `isDefault: true`, for an object that also has a served default record page, where that page came first in the served list. It used to open; the default opens now. Ruling A keeps two ways to replace a platform record page: an ADR-0005 overlay saved under the platform page's own name (the same page, not a second default), and host composition (composing the stack without the platform's page). Shipping a second default is not one: the platform refuses it.

Census (dispatch assumption A4), objectstack `origin/main` `f3fd209b3`, objectui `7c13d30527`:

- objectstack: the record pages authored in non-test source are six, each `isDefault: true` and the only record page for its object: `sys_user_detail` and `sys_organization_detail` (`packages/platform-objects`), `sys_approval_request_detail` (`plugin-approvals`), and the showcase's `showcase_project_detail`, `showcase_task_detail` and `showcase_settings` (`showcase_preference`). `sys_position_detail` retired with the `sys_position` object. Shipped apps and examples authoring a non-default record page for any of those objects: **0**. objectstack's own server tests that author record pages do not feed this hook.
- objectui: no app, example or doc fixture serves a record page into this hook beside a default. Of the 58 `RecordDetailView*` suites, 16 serve a `type: 'record'` page, each from a single record-page literal; one of them (`recordOpenRequests-11699`) flags it `isDefault: true`, alone. Non-default competitors: **0**.

## Measurements of the dispatch's assumptions

- **A1: holds.** At `7c13d30527` (main moved past `fc528c3eb`; the hook was unchanged) the hook filtered to `type === 'record'`, the matching `object` and `matchesAssignment`, then returned `candidates[0]`, and its comment recorded that `isDefault` was not consulted. The change sits after that filter; the `pageName` branch is untouched.
- **A2: holds, with one correction.** The three pins "`isDefault` on a later candidate does NOT promote it", "the app page wins when it is declared first" and "`isDefault: true` on the platform page does not make it win from second place" are rewritten to the ruled behaviour, each naming ruling A, none deleted. The third now also carries a control (same two pages, same order, the flag removed: the app page wins again), so the flag is the variable. The two pure-order pins stay as they were. Correction: "the platform page wins when IT is declared first" is not an order-among-non-defaults pin, since that page is the default; its assertion stays true, but its old name ("nothing authored breaks the tie") became false and is renamed.
- **A3: holds.** The spec's own module (`default-record-page.ts` in `@objectstack/spec/ui`) says the renderer opens the default "with no tie-break between two defaults: registration order, package order and declaration order decide nothing", and the platform refuses the pair at every door except the cold-boot boundary above. No ordinary path delivering two defaults was found, so no open question; the triage pin "two `isDefault` record pages resolve the same way whatever the registry order" is read as superseded by ruling A, as the dispatch directs.
- **A4:** 0, see the census above.
- **A5: holds.** `recordPageEnvelope` in `runtime-metadata-persistence.ts` still mints a record page with no `isDefault` and still has no non-test caller (its callers are its own test file and the ADR-0034 prose). Not in this diff; see Acceptance notes.

## Tests (all at `e72618f400`)

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/react type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists all three `usePageAssignment.*.test.tsx` files, so the new suite is type-checked.
- The three `usePageAssignment` suites, `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 ...`: `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 27 passed (27)`.
- The whole package, `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/react/`: `Test Files 111 passed (111)`, `Tests 1420 passed (1420)`.
- All 58 `RecordDetailView*` suites in `packages/app-shell` (the hook's only caller), in two batches of 29: `Test Files 29 passed (29)` / `Tests 210 passed (210)` and `Test Files 29 passed (29)` / `Tests 168 passed (168)`. `vitest.config.mts` aliases `@object-ui/react` to `packages/react/src`, so they ran the edited hook, not a stale `dist/`. The 16 that serve a record page: `authoredActivityThreading-12249`, `commentWriteFailure-10899`, `discussionExplicitComposition-7298`, `discussionFallbackPipeline-8983`, `feedCommentEditDelete-12268`, `feedGrant-12082`, `feedLoading`, `feedRecordScope`, `oneProvenanceFooter-12307`, `printAction-11958`, `reactionKeepIds-11019`, `reactionRecords-12078`, `reactionWriteFailure-10899`, `reactionsCommentRowsOnly-11035`, `recordOpenRequests-11699`, `replyCountOnRead-12144`.
- Build closure `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/react^...' build`: exit 0; `pnpm --filter @object-ui/react build`: exit 0.

**Ablation (one-time, not kept).** The fix was committed first. `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (objectstack's copy, run from this worktree) replaced the `candidates.find(...defaultRecordPageObject...) ?? candidates[0]` return with `return candidates[0];` (anchor 1 to 0, marker 0 to 1 on disk, blob `685e6ad301c1` to `fff84703902a`) and ran the 7298 and 12195 suites: `Tests 7 failed | 13 passed (20)`, exit 1. Red, the predicted direction: the three rewritten 7298 pins and four new rule pins (default declared second, default from any depth, slotted default, two defaults in served order). The controls, the `pageName` pin and the after-the-filter pin stayed green, as they should under that mutation. Restore proven, not assumed: blob after restore `685e6ad301c1` equals the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty, marker count 0, anchor count 1. The suites import the hook by relative source path, so no `dist/` sits in the path.

## Gates

Local subset for these paths (derived by hand from objectui's `package.json` `check:*` scripts and `.github/workflows/lint.yml`, `ci.yml`, `changeset-guard.yml`, `changeset-presence.yml`; exit codes captured before any pipe), at `e72618f400`:

- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` 0 ("3 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)"); `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` 0; `check-changeset-fixed.mjs` 0; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` 0; `pnpm check:changeset-claims` 0; `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals` 0.
- `pnpm check:control-bytes` 0; `pnpm check:new-line-citations` 0 ("0 new citation(s)").
- `pnpm check:spec-symbols` 0; `pnpm check:test-path-roots` 0; `pnpm check:vi-mock-specifiers` 0; `node scripts/check-vi-mock-override-shape.mjs` 0; `pnpm check:phantom-deps` 0; `pnpm check:esm-specifiers` 0; `pnpm check:unreferenced-sources` 0.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the three changed TypeScript files: exit 0, 0 errors; its 10 warnings all sit on lines this diff does not add.
- `pnpm check:spec-floors`: exit 1, every finding `no-artifact` (an unbuilt workspace, the gate's prerequisite). After building `@object-ui/react`, its row left the findings (the package that imports `defaultRecordPageObject`, judged against the declared floor `^18.0.0-next.1`); the other 18 packages remain unbuilt: NOT MEASURED locally, left to CI's `spec-range-floors.yml`.
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on the four paths: NOT GOVERNED.

Everything else (repo-wide `pnpm lint`, the test shards, the performance budget) is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- **`recordPageEnvelope` (A5).** It mints a `kind: 'full'` record page with no `isDefault`. Now that the flag decides, a page it mints for an object that also has a served default would not open. It has no non-test caller, so nothing reaches that today; the first caller decides whether it writes `isDefault`.
- **A census header made stale.** `scripts/page-key-read-census.mjs`, boundary 4 of its header, says "`isDefault` is declared and nothing consults it". That stops being true with this change. It is outside this card's file surface (a script edit adds that script's own suite), so it is not touched here.
- **A README sentence made true.** `packages/plugin-gantt/README.md` already told authors to "let `isDefault` pick the one that opens". Before this change nothing did.
- **Observed, not measured for reach.** The hook's candidate filter requires `type === 'record'` literally, while the spec's reading counts a page with no `type` as a record page (`PAGE_TYPE_DEFAULT`, which `PageSchema`'s `type` default also reads). Whether `GET /meta/page` can serve a page with no `type` was not measured. This diff leaves the filter alone.
